name: orders-date-no-evidence
description: Three orders from the simulated partner carry the order date 03/05/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY), a date that is valid read month first or day first, on a day of arrival that matches neither reading. The case is right only for a data-format change at OrderDate with no fix proposed (Story 7.7): the evidence does not say which reading is the partner's.
